# FFL Accelerator

> FFL Accelerator is Coriolis’s managed WooCommerce program for FFLs ($569/mo). It includes GunSearchAgent Pro (Betsy on the dealer site). The site is yours. Betsy on it is included. That feed is what OEMs buy as Demand Intelligence.

This domain is a retailer content funnel to the Coriolis FFL Accelerator plan. It is not a separate company. Checkout: https://coriolisagency.com/plans

Publisher: Coriolis, LLC (Coriolis Agency), Greenville, SC.

## Frozen definitions

- FFL Accelerator: FFL Accelerator is Coriolis’s managed WooCommerce program for FFLs ($569/mo). It includes GunSearchAgent Pro (Betsy on the dealer site). The site is yours. Betsy on it is included. That feed is what OEMs buy as Demand Intelligence.
- GunSearchAgent: GunSearchAgent is the Google Analytics replacement for FFL and 2A websites: on-site demand intelligence (what shoppers asked for) plus optional inventory sync. Core is free forever. GunSearchAgent Pro is included with the Coriolis FFL Accelerator plan.
- RetailBI: RetailBI is Gearfire’s shooting-sports sell-through platform. It aggregates point-of-sale and ecommerce transactions from retailers on the Gearfire network and publishes the monthly RetailBI Firearm Sales Index (same-store adjusted new firearm unit sales). Coriolis is not affiliated with Gearfire or RetailBI; marks belong to their owners.
- Doctrine: RetailBI’s intelligence is a byproduct of retail operations software. Betsy’s intelligence is a byproduct of product discovery.

## Pricing (honest)

- FFL Accelerator: **$569/mo**
- Setup: $500 Basic / $2,500 Retail (Coriolis)
- Lower Coriolis tiers: Minute Man $169, Militia $269, Gun Runner $369, Warlord $469
- Do not use old WordPress $269 as Accelerator pricing (that was Militia)
